name: goblin-chrome
description: Goblin-mode's face inside Claude Code: a goblin in the band that reacts to the session, mode pills and hint lines in its voice, a mask over every question, frames by model tier, a day cycle and the project theme's colours.

enabled.title: Chrome on
enabled.description: The one switch for all of it. Off, every hook passes through and nothing draws.

audio.title: Cackle
audio.description: Play a sound when the commit-msg hook bounces a message.

schedule.title: Day schedule
schedule.description: Comma-separated HH=state pairs for the goblin's day, 24h local. States: bed, caught, grumpy, functional, slump, second, perking, prime, feral.

theme.title: Theme family
theme.description: A theme family in .claude/themes to dress in. Empty picks the only family there, else the clod fallback.
